engine: SQLite STRICT ANY result exported by BookieE; LibreOffice Calc on Debian testing
case: Spreadsheet-application import and re-save of numeric, numeric-looking text and SQL NULL cells
contract: BookieE exports an integer 42 as an XLSX numeric cell, text "42" as a shared-string cell, and SQL NULL as a blank cell; accompanying runtime-kind labels are integer, text and null.
Calc opens the workbook and saves it as ODS without converting the numeric-looking text to a number or populating the blank NULL cell.
Calc reopens that ODS and saves XLSX; OOXML inspection confirms the integer remains numeric, the text remains a string with the same displayed value, and the NULL remains a missing/blank cell.
The checked workbook cells agree with the result's runtime-kind labels.

bookiee_export.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=/home/trung/Projects/tablepro/linux/docs/evidence/sqlite-xlsx-calc-reimport-results-2026-10-04/source.xlsx cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_compound_any_result_exports_csv_text_and_xlsx_cell_kinds -- --test-threads=1

steps: Open source.xlsx with LibreOffice Calc and save as calc-roundtrip.ods.
Reopen calc-roundtrip.ods with LibreOffice Calc and save as calc-roundtrip.xlsx.

consumer_assertions.method: Python standard-library ZIP/XML checks over ODS content.xml and XLSX worksheet/shared strings; assertions fail unless both app import/export steps preserve the checked cell kinds and values.

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings
